identityReview.rule: The user-approved generated V4 front-face lock may parent downstream V4 renders as a translation control, but it never replaces or outranks the real Lulu identity evidence.

canonicalFlow.rule: The garment set is established before model work. FACE draws from the complete real-photo authority stack plus the generated V4 translation control. A deliberately declared holistic subject synthesis may re-render the full frame; if the user approves that entire frame, it is rebased as the garment-specific subject lock. Hair stays unchanged unless explicitly restyled; accessories may rotate after the subject lock passes. 006 and 007 are independent siblings from accepted 005 and never parent one another. Face, body, room and garment references are an adaptive toolkit. The final gate is realistic full-body Lulu likeness, body balance, attitude, presence, pose, garment truth and believable scene integration.

garment.rule: 006 means the user-approved two-piece look: matte-black fitted short-sleeve crop tee plus high-waisted silver reflective ruched pencil midi skirt with exactly one centre-front slit. Preserve the small waist gap, irregular crinkled reflections, restrained close silhouette and real garment weight. Rear construction remains unknown.

identity.rule: Every FACE operation must use the complete independent authority stack together: verified F01-F10 multi-angle contact sheet, recovered raw frontal close-up, recovered raw open-eye three-quarter photograph, real-photo frontal face lock, and user-approved generated V4 translation lock. The active full operation board packages F01-F10 plus the exact open-eye and frontal PNG copies into one private reference so none is omitted at the five-image tool boundary; it is not new evidence. The generated lock supplies repeatable geometry but never replaces or outranks the real-photo layers. Accepted 001/05 and 004/05 are translation guidance only. Hair stays unchanged from the accepted V4 styling unless the user explicitly restyles it.

body.rule: Real Lulu photos remain body evidence truth. The V4 source and three-view plate are user-approved modeled silhouette and garment-transfer controls, not verified measurements. Use an angle crop or the combined plate according to which supports the more realistic complete frame. For Garment 006, the corrected 05 r006 is the accepted front master; side/rear body crops and matching Garment 004 angles control heel-aware stature and angle balance in the independent siblings. Preserve the body as a believable whole rather than optimizing isolated measurements.

atelier.rule: The room is the permanent JUW setting. Preserve its icon, layout, vase, rail, garments, ottoman, rug and warm-neutral identity. Minor generative texture or lighting variance is acceptable when total realism improves; redesign or structural drift is not.

brand.rule: The wall icon is inherited from the locked room and may not be regenerated.

semanticMediaRoles.rule: Semantic role names are authoritative. Numeric slots are presentation and packet conventions only; map by role before export, database sync or Shop publication.

outputFormat.rule: One clean full-resolution image without labels, panels, text or crops.

accepted06.note: The accepted 006 is preserved as its own output. It is not an input, parent, prerequisite or authority for 007.

accepted07.note: The accepted 007 branches directly from 005 and the canonical stack. It is not an input, parent, prerequisite or authority for 006.
